target_customer: Robotics developers and pilot partners wanting low-cost arms that learn tasks from demonstrations
problem: Robot arms are costly and hard to teach new tasks. The company sells low-cost developer kits and learning software so robots pick up tasks from a few demonstrations.
business_model: Hardware developer kits plus learning software, with pilots for customers
product_category: Robot learning hardware kits and software

founders.name: Jannik Grothusen
founders.background_notes: YC page says two years of robot learning research at UC Berkeley and TU Munich. Roles not specified.

competitors.name: PrismaX
competitors.what: Platform for teleoperation, data and models for robotics

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines low-cost arm hardware with learning control software that must generalize from few demonstrations. Robot learning remained research-grade work for a single founder.

defensibility.rationale: Open source robot learning tools and many funded robotics startups lower barriers. No proprietary data or patents are stated.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded physical AI data and robot learning companies emerged in 2025 and 2026, such as XDOF raising 70M in June 2026. No source shows them acting against this company.

market_need_then: Physical AI funding was surging in 2025 and teams wanted cheaper robot platforms and data. Evidence for this company's demand is its pilot call on the YC page.

branding.domain_note: Uses robot-learning.co, a descriptive .co domain. No acquisition story found.

identity.logo: not described by any source found

branding.community_and_virality: Product line named TRLC-DK1 per aggregator; no community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic descriptive name that is hard to search for. No brand press found.

outcome_analysis: The Robot Learning Company is an active one person Spring 2025 YC company. Aggregators report a roughly 500K round in June 2025 and a TRLC-DK1 developer kit. No acquisition or shutdown is reported. Hardware plus research for a solo founder is hard, and location and headcount are contradictory across sources.
notes: The website robot-learning.co could not be fetched because the safety check was rate limited. Round stage is other: VCBacked says pre-seed, Startupintros says seed, and all amounts come from aggregators (PitchBook, VCBacked, Startupintros agree on 500K). Caplight shows about 1M total and a September 2025 seed, unverified. PitchBook gives Munich and about 5 staff; YC says San Francisco on one page fetch and Germany on another with team size 1.
